metadata.title: Vistaar CRM Express-to-FastAPI Route Parity Matrix
metadata.discrepancy_explanation: Earlier reports noted 131 FastAPI routes due to 127 unique endpoints + 4 trailing-slash aliases (/conversations/ and /whatsapp-accounts/). With the 2 AI Draft routes ported, FastAPI has 129 unique canonical routes (matching all 129 Express routes exactly) and 133 total route definitions including the 4 aliases.

intentionally_excluded.reason: Development wiping and mock-seeding utility strictly excluded from production builds for data safety.

authentication.verification: Byte-identical 401 error payloads, argon2/bcrypt password hashing, SameSite refresh cookie compatibility.

meta_webhook.verification: HMAC-SHA256 signature checking using META_APP_SECRET, challenge response echo on GET.

conversations_and_ai_drafts.verification: Conversation access authorization, ADR-005 PII sanitization in LLM prompt generation, draft outcome lifecycle transitions.

whatsapp_delivery.verification: Distributed MongoDB lease claiming via findOneAndUpdate, quiet hours checks, opt-out gating.

background_schedulers.verification: uniq_daily_job_run distributed unique index locking across processes; separated dedicated worker process (app.worker).
